lines.zh: 我一步一步地走过平原
lines.en: I cross the plains, step by step.
My tail sweeps the grass aside.

lines.zh: 我每一步都把土压出坑
lines.en: Each step presses a pit into the soil.
My gait is heavy, and the ground answers.
I circle near my anchor point.
I turn to take in the surroundings.

lines.zh: 我从热带草原的边缘过来
lines.en: I come from the edge of the savanna.
I move forward with my head low.
Two strides bring me to the tree.
I walk slowly up to you.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地追着味道
lines.en: I follow the scent, step by step.
I lift my head and test the wind.

lines.zh: 我跨过一截倒下的树干
lines.en: I step across a fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 我的影子在草上拖得很长
lines.en: My shadow stretches long over the grass.

lines.zh: 我站在平原上，尾巴摆着
lines.en: I stand on the plain, tail swaying.
I am waiting for whatever comes next.
I claw the dirt, restless with waiting.
It is open here; I like it.
I open my jaws slowly.

lines.zh: 远处有东西踩断了树枝
lines.en: Something snaps a branch far off.
Every breath of mine carries heat.
I stand there without moving.
My hide is red.
I turn my head to the sun.
I am thinking about eating.
I shake the ash off my back.
My anchor is over there.
I am in no hurry.
You are standing by my feet.

lines.zh: 我把脑袋压低了看清你
lines.en: I lower my head to see you clearly.
Are you carrying food?
I am gauging your weight.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道我不认得
lines.en: I do not know the smell you carry.
I know a trainer's gestures.
Give the signal and I lie down.
I blink once, and slowly.
Data flows around you.
I stand and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 你让我想起以前的主人
lines.en: You remind me of a former partner.
I sit down beside you.
If there is meat ahead, I will go.
I offer my claw to you.
If I meant to bite, I would have.

lines.zh: 我低下大头，算打过招呼
lines.en: I dip my big head in greeting.
I growl and give half a step.
A gash is opened in my hide.
I keep that in mind.
I shake myself.

lines.zh: 疼得我尾巴扫倒一片草
lines.en: The pain whips my tail through the grass.
That blow only makes me tilt.
I slowly steady my weight.
This wound cannot hold me back.
I clamp my upper and lower teeth.
I am not down yet.
Is that meat in your hand?

lines.zh: 我鼻子朝你手心凑过去
lines.en: My snout drifts toward your palm.
I lower my head and sniff.
Hold it higher and I cannot reach.
This little bit will not fill me.
My mouth is open and waiting.
Set it down first.
I finish it in a few bites.
This beats anything I find in the wild.
I lick my teeth; still hungry.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子蹭了蹭你的手
lines.en: I nudge your hand with my snout.
Did you make this?

lines.zh: 你整个人撞上我的胸口
lines.en: You crash into my chest.
I did not give a step.
You are thrown quite a way off.

lines.zh: 你的脚正压住我的爪子
lines.en: Your foot is on my claw.
I step over you without treading on you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我晃了晃
lines.en: We collide, and I sway.
My hide is thick; I felt nothing.
Do not stand where I put my feet.
I draw my claws back half a pace.
You are not hurt anywhere?

lines.zh: 我是被训练出来打仗的
lines.en: I was raised to fight.
I do not think of such things much.
I have only my anchor and a few meals.
No need to bring that up.
I wag my tail.
I crouch down where I am.
I need nobody at all.
The plains are big enough.
I walk on.

lines.zh: 我从鼻子里重重哼了一声
lines.en: I snort heavily through my nose.
I pick it up and look it over.
Can this be eaten?
I swallow it without chewing.
I pin it under one claw.
It slips from my teeth.
Whosever it was, I eat it first.
I fling it to one side.
This has not a trace of taste.
I spit the bone out.
I bury it in a pit.
Something has drawn close.
I turn my body on it.
My teeth are showing.
I am readying my fire.
I lower my body.
This patch is my territory.
It is held in my stare.
It has entered my range.
A roar comes up my throat.
I move before it does.
It should not have come so near.
Fire has gathered in my throat.
I bear down inch by inch.
My tail pulls into a line.
I watch which foot it moves first.

lines.zh: 它每退一步我就近一爪
lines.en: Each step it retreats, I gain a claw's length.

lines.zh: 我爪下的草被连根翻起
lines.en: My claws tear grass up by the roots.
Each move of its, I count.
It retreats, I follow.
There is no cover for it here.
I crouch, tail pulled straight.

lines.zh: 火光在我嘴里聚起来了
lines.en: Fire is gathering in my jaws.
It is close enough now.
There is no escaping this.
I throw myself at it.
I bite, twist, and throw it down.
The impact drives it back several steps.

lines.zh: 我的前爪把它按进土里
lines.en: My foreclaw drives it into the dirt.
I bring a claw down.
It slips aside.
My tail catches it.
It draws back; I hold my spot.
I follow up with another blow.
A scratch shows on my red hide.
It is still standing.
I have not used my fire yet.
I have been placed on these plains.
My anchor has settled here.
I raise my head to the open ground.

lines.zh: 我的爪子第一次踩上这片草
lines.en: My claws touch this grass for the first time.
I take shape out of the data stream.
I shake and find my footing.
There is wind here, and grass.
I have chosen this spot.
I scan the surroundings slowly.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一扫，草全伏下去
lines.en: One sweep of my tail and the grass lies flat.
I settle down and claim this ground.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，很远都听得见
lines.en: I call out, and it carries far.
I draw my claws back.
I have only just been let out.
Fire burns my red hide.
I fall from somewhere high.
Water pours down my windpipe.

lines.zh: 爆风掀翻我，我翻身站起
lines.en: The blast flips me; I roll back onto my feet.
An arrow pins into my spine.

lines.zh: 魔法把我的数据打乱了
lines.en: Magic scrambles my data.
Hunger makes my legs feel hollow.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我抖了一下
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and I twitch.
The ground under my feet is gone.
